purpose: Official interface references inspected before the completion implementation. Documentation does not establish installed CLI behavior, isolation or production trust. Native observations and explicit limits are separate.

sources.inspected: JSONL machine-readable lifecycle and output-last-message interface
sources.limit: No guarantee that process exit0 alone establishes an acceptable final answer or semantic correctness.

sources.inspected: Provider HTTP retry, SSE retry and idle-timeout configuration
sources.limit: Declared configuration is not measured effective behavior; previous and current owned-stub observations count attempts separately.

sources.inspected: CODEX_CA_CERTIFICATE selects a PEM CA bundle and takes precedence over fallback SSL_CERT_FILE. CODEX_HOME sets per-process state root.
sources.limit: Documentation does not prove the installed native binary loads this bundle or excludes host trust. Only local test outcomes can support those narrower claims.

sources.inspected: Custom CA bundle interface and no-auth custom-provider configuration with credential settings omitted
sources.limit: No real login, auth refresh, OAuth, keychain, credential helper or external provider exercised.

sources.inspected: Command network proxy and client model/authentication connections have different scopes
sources.limit: A command proxy is not global client isolation; outer OS profile and locally observed transport evidence remain necessary.

sources.inspected: TLS explicit CA, default rejectUnauthorized validation and host-name checkServerIdentity verification; corroborated through Context7 /nodejs/node
sources.limit: Do not disable peer or host-name verification. Owned self-signed trust controls are not evidence of production certificates, host trust stores or native Codex TLS unless separately observed.

sources.inspected: POSIX detached spawn creates a new process group and session
sources.limit: Killing one process group does not prove all detached descendants were killed; owned bounded fixtures establish only the observed local case.

sources.inspected: HTTP redirect semantics, method preservation for307/308 and origin-aware handling of sensitive headers
sources.limit: A standard describes protocol rules, not the installed client's behavior. Retain actual broker requests and deny foreign destinations before forwarding.
